analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($81,664.14) vs SMA5($81,650.21)/SMA20($83,315.68)/SMA50($81,391.26): above short-term, below mid-term.
· Strong above SMA100($74,197.69)/SMA200($72,493.62): maintaining mid-to-long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (40.9%) + entering historical mid-range at current price level.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (51.9→47.3): staying in neutral zone, signaling a downward turn.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-525.1800→-478.5821): improving, attempting to break out of bearish convergence.
· Bollinger Bands current price position (mid-band $83,315.68): range-bound near the mid-band, bandwidth (7.39%) is at normal levels.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($80,659.81): above Pivot S1($78,551.22), based on moving averages.
· Swing resistance ($82,262.21): approaching current price, potential for short-term bullish reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: Higher Low not met, Lower High not met → range-bound diagnosis.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.62): contracted compared to 5-day average, reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): wait-and-see conditions for directional confirmation.
